verdict.rationale: Asana is a work-management SaaS, and a coding agent that detects and installs toolchains and dependencies is outside its product category. Its AI Teammates and MCP server handle tasks, projects and reporting, not code execution environments. No evidence shows Asana ships a coding agent, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have a coding agent auto-detect and install the toolchains and dependencies it needs for a task
